experiments.title: Rain impacts that belong to the ocean surface
experiments.hypothesis: A bounded surface-wave response may make rain impacts more coherent without reducing the ocean's existing detail or changing the rendering backend.
experiments.rationale: Compare a method's actual assumptions and cost with this site's shoreline and water scale before writing a shader.

primary_sources.title: Generalizing Shallow Water Simulations with Dispersive Surface Waves, SIGGRAPH 2023
fit_notes: Model inspected extracted methods/appendices; coordinator checked primary scale, decomposition cost and omitted forces. Direct PDF bytes and figure pixels were unavailable in that run.
A complete SWE/FFT port is not justified for small rain impacts. Start with a 16-trajectory first-contact/ownership audit; no rendering qualification or browser cost claim.

limits: Bounded first-contact and ocean-normal approximation is published and locally/live verified; this is not a reproduction of the primary shallow-water solver.
Rainy native full-quality coast still has roughly50ms frame median. Pool rain, crowns, volumetric water and whole-scene performance remain unqualified.

gates.expectation: First-contact/ownership and actual displaced-water sampling controls remain exact; current actual652-event comparison is separately retained.
Method and current renderer admission are separate. Preserve the original numerical/physical omissions and public rain quality.
Native2K/4K paired cost and modernWebKit/live captures are retained; no overall speedup or physical-iPhone claim.

experiments.next_step: Read the published rain review and current material-cache research note. Any pool/crown/SWE extension is a new proposed experiment with owning paths, controls and admission; do not rerun or relabel the completed first-contact checkpoint.

experiments.title: Angle-stable house lighting without blanket brightening
experiments.hypothesis: A measured separation of view-dependent reflection and diffuse transport may explain the reported overbright angle before a bounded lighting correction is selected.
experiments.rationale: An abstract about light sampling is a lead to inspect, not evidence that a neural method fits this scene or backend.

primary_sources.title: Neural Visibility Cache for Real-Time Light Sampling, JCGT 14(2), 2025-08-18

limits: The primary entry was discovered; no WebGL-house fit is claimed.
First reproduce the specific camera-dependent failure with GPU uniform and source bindings.

gates.expectation: Match room, clock, fixture schedule and actual shader uniforms across angles; distinguish diffuse, specular and reflection errors.
Retain noon/evening/night public camera and Walk frames with no exposure, room-content or shadow reductions.
Keep full first-ready assets and inspect later bathroom/Walk visits for missed compilation.

experiments.next_step: Reproduce the reported angle-dependent brightness and review the primary method's fit; let the coordinator reserve any additional owning light paths.

experiments.title: Current rendering methods compared with this complete scene
experiments.hypothesis: A source-backed comparison of current production methods can identify one testable quality or startup improvement that preserves the complete scene.
experiments.rationale: Use current primary material to choose a bounded experiment rather than replacing the renderer on a title or benchmark alone.

primary_sources.title: SIGGRAPH 2026 Advances in Real-Time Rendering in Games
fit_notes: Course syllabus and abstracts were read; individual methods and this scene's fit remain unreviewed.

limits: No renderer qualification follows from a course abstract.
Concurrent startup profiles and software WebGL are functional evidence, not a native PC GPU speed comparison.

gates.expectation: Read retained trained/neural/FFT/startup attempts; state what changes the next hypothesis.
Bind the complete production file inventory and program/asset census; do not omit assets, rooms or first-ready interactions.
Request an exclusive quiet window for matched native clocks, avatar/pose, actual viewport/buffer/MSAA/backend and source/model/cache before a cost claim.

experiments.next_step: Review one complete method and its available implementation, then propose a single leased experiment with runnable correctness gates.

experiments.title: Reuse static material evaluation while keeping scene dependencies live
experiments.hypothesis: Caching static geometry/material evaluation behind explicit dependency generations may avoid repeated work without freezing final lighting, water, actors or occlusion.
experiments.rationale: Actual complete-world dirty-tile coverage varies greatly by view and small camera changes; final-color freezing has no correctness certificate.

primary_sources.title: HiPR: Hierarchical Progressive Rendering for Immediate Feedback, SIGGRAPH2026 Real-Time Live extended abstract
fit_notes: Complete three-page text reviewed: object/depth visibility, discovered transport dependencies, priority scheduling and eventual full update; reference uses Vulkan inline rays.
The proposed raster material cache is an original bounded adaptation, not HiPR. A target-image difference oracle cannot discover dependencies or demonstrate saved rendering work.

limits: Source-bound temporal readback census is not a runtime reuse predictor, cost measurement or SOTA reproduction.
Prior exact-pixel batching regressed frame pacing; whole-scene nativeGPU/driver attribution is required before another submission rewrite.

gates.expectation: Exact border/channel accounting and oracle reconstruction pass; diagnostic thresholds never replace exact masks.
Define source/camera/projection, geometry/material/visibility and light/reflection invalidation. Unknown dependencies fall back; no production hook before a reviewed executable correctness gate.
Full product, held-out views/motion/lighting, quiet native ABBA with driver attribution, startup/memory/p95 and WebKit/iPhone fallback. No draw-count-only or oracle-skipped-work claim.

experiments.next_step: Review the retained census and method note; propose one unused lab cache with explicit invalidation and runnable correctness controls before marking ready. Preserve original renderer as fallback; do not touch the coordinator-owned controller.

experiments.title: Learn one owned expensive material with a measured browser decoder
experiments.hypothesis: A small trained surface-appearance model may replace one expensive owned procedural material at a better measured quality/cost point.
experiments.rationale: Current neural material work separates training reliability and inference hardware; neither its performance nor older failed Gaussian results can be transferred to this browser.
